import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='model_year', y='price_usd', hue='sensor_type', 
                size='megapixels', style='body_type', sizes=(20, 200))
for idx, row in data.iterrows():
    plt.text(row['model_year'], row['price_usd'], row['brand'], 
             fontsize=9, ha='right', va='bottom')
plt.title('Camera Price vs Year with Megapixels and Sensor Type')
plt.xlabel('Model Year')
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)')
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300)
